zh: 连通分量数只和“哪些点被边连在了一起”有关；重边、自环不会带来新的连通关系，孤立点各自算一个分量。
用并查集：一开始每个点自成一个分量，共 n 个；处理每条边时，若两个端点的根不同就合并，分量数减一，根相同则不变。
初始化 parent[i]=i、size[i]=1、answer=n；对每条边 (u,v) 用带路径压缩的 find 求出两个根，不同则按大小把小树挂到大树下并让 answer 减一；所有边处理完输出 answer。
en: The number of connected components only depends on which nodes the edges join together; duplicate edges and self-loops add no new connectivity, and each isolated node is its own component.
Use union-find: initially every node is its own component, n in total; for each edge, if the two endpoints have different roots, merge them and decrease the count by one, otherwise nothing changes.

Initialize parent[i]=i, size[i]=1 and answer=n; for each edge (u,v) find both roots with path compression, and if they differ attach the smaller tree under the larger one and decrement answer; print answer after all edges.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use union-find to merge the two endpoints of each edge; there are n components initially, and each merge of two different roots removes one.

## Correctness

Initially every node is on its own, and adding an edge can only connect the two components containing its endpoints. If the roots differ the count drops by exactly one; if they are the same nothing changes. After all edges are processed, the structure reflects exactly the connectivity of the graph.

## Complexity

Time O((n+m) alpha(n)), space O(n+m) including the input.
